meta.title: Dark Course
meta.description: The dark world will swallow hesitant souls, and their wounded forms can only continue their course in the darkness, awaiting daylight.

units.rawText: Jiutian sector, aboard the flagship of the Jovian Ringworld Fleet
units.displayText: Jiutian sector, aboard the flagship of the Jovian Ringworld Fleet

spans.text: Jiutian sector, aboard the flagship of the Jovian Ringworld Fleet

units.rawText: Area C, a new comet has entered interception range, block it with the magnetic shield. After that, deploy the operand barrier immediately to cut the landed entropics off from the comet.
units.displayText: Area C, a new comet has entered interception range, block it with the magnetic shield. After that, deploy the operand barrier immediately to cut the landed entropics off from the comet.

spans.text: Area C, a new comet has entered interception range, block it with the magnetic shield. After that, deploy the operand barrier immediately to cut the landed entropics off from the comet.

units.rawText: Areas A and B, maintain your current fields of fire. All units, take turns firing; you must not let a single entropic creature through!
units.displayText: Areas A and B, maintain your current fields of fire. All units, take turns firing; you must not let a single entropic creature through!

spans.text: Areas A and B, maintain your current fields of fire. All units, take turns firing; you must not let a single entropic creature through!

units.rawText: Team 08 just reported in; they've eliminated the entropics who made it past the Ringworld.
units.displayText: Team 08 just reported in; they've eliminated the entropics who made it past the Ringworld.

spans.text: Team 08 just reported in; they've eliminated the entropics who made it past the Ringworld.

units.rawText: We won't have to worry about the entropics pursuing Xinghuan and the others for now. Judging by the time... They've probably crossed Mars' orbit by now.
units.displayText: We won't have to worry about the entropics pursuing Xinghuan and the others for now. Judging by the time... They've probably crossed Mars' orbit by now.

spans.text: We won't have to worry about the entropics pursuing Xinghuan and the others for now. Judging by the time... They've probably crossed Mars' orbit by now.

units.rawText: Belka, how are things at the blockade array?
units.displayText: Belka, how are things at the blockade array?

spans.text: Belka, how are things at the blockade array?

units.rawText: According to the observational data from Astarte Spaceport, all the entropics are being held outside the blockade and there are no signs of entropic incursion on Jupiter's surface.
units.displayText: According to the observational data from Astarte Spaceport, all the entropics are being held outside the blockade and there are no signs of entropic incursion on Jupiter's surface.

spans.text: According to the observational data from Astarte Spaceport, all the entropics are being held outside the blockade and there are no signs of entropic incursion on Jupiter's surface.

units.rawText: Whew... Looks like establishing the blockade array against the entropic comets was an effective strategy. The array depends on various devices in the Jovian rings, so pay close attention to Jupiter's status.
units.displayText: Whew... Looks like establishing the blockade array against the entropic comets was an effective strategy. The array depends on various devices in the Jovian rings, so pay close attention to Jupiter's status.

spans.text: Whew... Looks like establishing the blockade array against the entropic comets was an effective strategy. The array depends on various devices in the Jovian rings, so pay close attention to Jupiter's status.

units.rawText: Gagarin, how goes the entropic extermination?
units.displayText: Gagarin, how goes the entropic extermination?

spans.text: Gagarin, how goes the entropic extermination?

units.rawText: All entropics within the Area A operand barrier have been exterminated. Moving on to Area B.
units.displayText: All entropics within the Area A operand barrier have been exterminated. Moving on to Area B.

spans.text: All entropics within the Area A operand barrier have been exterminated. Moving on to Area B.

units.rawText: Lower the Area A operand barrier and make sure the other areas have adequate operand supplies. An entropic comet is about to reach Area D.
units.displayText: Lower the Area A operand barrier and make sure the other areas have adequate operand supplies. An entropic comet is about to reach Area D.

spans.text: Lower the Area A operand barrier and make sure the other areas have adequate operand supplies. An entropic comet is about to reach Area D.

units.rawText: Yuwang stares hard at the screen. Three comets have already been stopped by the magnetic shield.
units.displayText: Yuwang stares hard at the screen. Three comets have already been stopped by the magnetic shield.

spans.text: Yuwang stares hard at the screen. Three comets have already been stopped by the magnetic shield.

units.rawText: They were originally meant to prevent space junk from hitting the ringworld, but they have proven tremendously useful for this purpose.
units.displayText: They were originally meant to prevent space junk from hitting the ringworld, but they have proven tremendously useful for this purpose.

spans.text: They were originally meant to prevent space junk from hitting the ringworld, but they have proven tremendously useful for this purpose.

units.rawText: The enemy keeps pouring in...
units.displayText: The enemy keeps pouring in...

spans.text: The enemy keeps pouring in...

units.rawText: Sir, another comet is heading for Area B, it's quite large...
units.displayText: Sir, another comet is heading for Area B, it's quite large...

spans.text: Sir, another comet is heading for Area B, it's quite large...

units.rawText: But Area B is still engaged with their first comet, they can't spare the troops to stop a second.
units.displayText: But Area B is still engaged with their first comet, they can't spare the troops to stop a second.

spans.text: But Area B is still engaged with their first comet, they can't spare the troops to stop a second.

units.rawText: Lord Yuwang, please allow the Ringworld Expeditionary Forces to directly intercept this batch of comets. I will lead them!
units.displayText: Lord Yuwang, please allow the Ringworld Expeditionary Forces to directly intercept this batch of comets. I will lead them!

spans.text: Lord Yuwang, please allow the Ringworld Expeditionary Forces to directly intercept this batch of comets. I will lead them!

units.rawText: I'll be counting on you, then. Belka, go with Gagarin.
units.displayText: I'll be counting on you, then. Belka, go with Gagarin.

spans.text: I'll be counting on you, then. Belka, go with Gagarin.

units.rawText: Teams 03, 04, and 05, your mission has changed. Follow Gagarin's command and prioritize dealing with the new comets. Area B personnel be advised, focus all your efforts on the first comet!
units.displayText: Teams 03, 04, and 05, your mission has changed. Follow Gagarin's command and prioritize dealing with the new comets. Area B personnel be advised, focus all your efforts on the first comet!

spans.text: Teams 03, 04, and 05, your mission has changed. Follow Gagarin's command and prioritize dealing with the new comets. Area B personnel be advised, focus all your efforts on the first comet!

units.rawText: Kaboom!
units.displayText: Kaboom!

spans.text: Kaboom!

units.rawText: In Area B, the incoming comet suddenly picks up speed, attempting to destroy all the nearby buildings with a tremendous impact. The transparent shield slowly rises again and captures the comet within itself.
units.displayText: In Area B, the incoming comet suddenly picks up speed, attempting to destroy all the nearby buildings with a tremendous impact. The transparent shield slowly rises again and captures the comet within itself.

spans.text: In Area B, the incoming comet suddenly picks up speed, attempting to destroy all the nearby buildings with a tremendous impact. The transparent shield slowly rises again and captures the comet within itself.

units.rawText: The sky goes dark as the comet hits. Ear-piercing alarms ring throughout the base.
units.displayText: The sky goes dark as the comet hits. Ear-piercing alarms ring throughout the base.

spans.text: The sky goes dark as the comet hits. Ear-piercing alarms ring throughout the base.

units.rawText: (Wailing)
units.displayText: (Wailing)

spans.text: (Wailing)

units.rawText: The comet suddenly sped up and we've detected a cometary impact at Astarte Spaceport! Large numbers of entropics are making Ring-fall.
units.displayText: The comet suddenly sped up and we've detected a cometary impact at Astarte Spaceport! Large numbers of entropics are making Ring-fall.

spans.text: The comet suddenly sped up and we've detected a cometary impact at Astarte Spaceport! Large numbers of entropics are making Ring-fall.

units.rawText: What's the shield's status?
units.displayText: What's the shield's status?

spans.text: What's the shield's status?

units.rawText: It's been successfully deployed and the blockade on the whole is stable.
units.displayText: It's been successfully deployed and the blockade on the whole is stable.

spans.text: It's been successfully deployed and the blockade on the whole is stable.

units.rawText: All point defense turrets get ready, target the incoming comets and fire—
units.displayText: All point defense turrets get ready, target the incoming comets and fire—

spans.text: All point defense turrets get ready, target the incoming comets and fire—

units.rawText: Streams of high-energy projectiles slash through the air in the direction of the dark purple comets falling toward them.
units.displayText: Streams of high-energy projectiles slash through the air in the direction of the dark purple comets falling toward them.

spans.text: Streams of high-energy projectiles slash through the air in the direction of the dark purple comets falling toward them.

units.rawText: Kaboom!
units.displayText: Kaboom!

spans.text: Kaboom!

units.rawText: The comets explode in mid-air and dark-purple smoke fills the sky above the Ringworld. However, this interception fire poses no threat to these ominous objects, and they mercilessly strike the surface.
units.displayText: The comets explode in mid-air and dark-purple smoke fills the sky above the Ringworld. However, this interception fire poses no threat to these ominous objects, and they mercilessly strike the surface.

spans.text: The comets explode in mid-air and dark-purple smoke fills the sky above the Ringworld. However, this interception fire poses no threat to these ominous objects, and they mercilessly strike the surface.

units.rawText: The main comet swarm has been stopped. Entropic forces have landed near Astarte Spaceport.
units.displayText: The main comet swarm has been stopped. Entropic forces have landed near Astarte Spaceport.

spans.text: The main comet swarm has been stopped. Entropic forces have landed near Astarte Spaceport.

units.rawText: On the screen, entropic creatures quickly infest the spaces between the buildings, the buildings themselves, and the streets. Everywhere they go is covered by a dense network of purple strands.
units.displayText: On the screen, entropic creatures quickly infest the spaces between the buildings, the buildings themselves, and the streets. Everywhere they go is covered by a dense network of purple strands.

spans.text: On the screen, entropic creatures quickly infest the spaces between the buildings, the buildings themselves, and the streets. Everywhere they go is covered by a dense network of purple strands.

units.rawText: Team 05, encircle the entropics that have already landed. Do your best to keep them from spreading; we need to buy time for our comrades to take out those comets.
units.displayText: Team 05, encircle the entropics that have already landed. Do your best to keep them from spreading; we need to buy time for our comrades to take out those comets.

spans.text: Team 05, encircle the entropics that have already landed. Do your best to keep them from spreading; we need to buy time for our comrades to take out those comets.

units.rawText: The concentrated gunfire forms an invisible wall that keeps the entropics about 20 meters away. As more comets land, an endless swarm of entropics fills the gaps in the frontline.
units.displayText: The concentrated gunfire forms an invisible wall that keeps the entropics about 20 meters away. As more comets land, an endless swarm of entropics fills the gaps in the frontline.

spans.text: The concentrated gunfire forms an invisible wall that keeps the entropics about 20 meters away. As more comets land, an endless swarm of entropics fills the gaps in the frontline.

units.rawText: A dense pack of entropics has been sighted in the spaceport. They're trying to break through the firepower blockade.
units.displayText: A dense pack of entropics has been sighted in the spaceport. They're trying to break through the firepower blockade.

spans.text: A dense pack of entropics has been sighted in the spaceport. They're trying to break through the firepower blockade.

units.rawText: Turn up the heat! Team 04, head to the spaceport frontline to support them.
units.displayText: Turn up the heat! Team 04, head to the spaceport frontline to support them.

spans.text: Turn up the heat! Team 04, head to the spaceport frontline to support them.

units.rawText: Warning— High-energy entropization reaction detected in Astarte Spaceport. All agents, evacuate immediately.
units.displayText: Warning— High-energy entropization reaction detected in Astarte Spaceport. All agents, evacuate immediately.

spans.text: Warning— High-energy entropization reaction detected in Astarte Spaceport. All agents, evacuate immediately.

units.rawText: Astarte Spaceport is on the Ringworld and it's closest to Jupiter. How could a comet from extrasolar space have gotten here in an instant...
units.displayText: Astarte Spaceport is on the Ringworld and it's closest to Jupiter. How could a comet from extrasolar space have gotten here in an instant...

spans.text: Astarte Spaceport is on the Ringworld and it's closest to Jupiter. How could a comet from extrasolar space have gotten here in an instant...

units.rawText: Gagarin! We've lost contact with Astarte Spaceport!
units.displayText: Gagarin! We've lost contact with Astarte Spaceport!

spans.text: Gagarin! We've lost contact with Astarte Spaceport!

units.rawText: But how?!
units.displayText: But how?!

spans.text: But how?!

units.rawText: The inner side of the Ringworld is closest to Jupiter, which means it is quite dark even when under direct sunlight, and today's sunlight seems especially dim.
units.displayText: The inner side of the Ringworld is closest to Jupiter, which means it is quite dark even when under direct sunlight, and today's sunlight seems especially dim.

spans.text: The inner side of the Ringworld is closest to Jupiter, which means it is quite dark even when under direct sunlight, and today's sunlight seems especially dim.

units.rawText: On the screen, the agents deploy the HQ's shield. The massive barrier seems to sparkle with scattered points of light.
units.displayText: On the screen, the agents deploy the HQ's shield. The massive barrier seems to sparkle with scattered points of light.

spans.text: On the screen, the agents deploy the HQ's shield. The massive barrier seems to sparkle with scattered points of light.

units.rawText: The purple color spreading from these points corrupts the shield in a matter of minutes!
units.displayText: The purple color spreading from these points corrupts the shield in a matter of minutes!

spans.text: The purple color spreading from these points corrupts the shield in a matter of minutes!

units.rawText: Detecting breaches in the shield caused by entropization!
units.displayText: Detecting breaches in the shield caused by entropization!

spans.text: Detecting breaches in the shield caused by entropization!

units.rawText: Packs of entropics drop in through the holes in the sky, until they form a small hill in front of the defenders. As more and more entropics discover how to breach the shield, they pour in endlessly through the gaps in the sky.
units.displayText: Packs of entropics drop in through the holes in the sky, until they form a small hill in front of the defenders. As more and more entropics discover how to breach the shield, they pour in endlessly through the gaps in the sky.

spans.text: Packs of entropics drop in through the holes in the sky, until they form a small hill in front of the defenders. As more and more entropics discover how to breach the shield, they pour in endlessly through the gaps in the sky.

units.rawText: Beep— It seems something has hit the camera. The camera lens shakes violently and then the transmission cuts out.
units.displayText: Beep— It seems something has hit the camera. The camera lens shakes violently and then the transmission cuts out.

spans.text: Beep— It seems something has hit the camera. The camera lens shakes violently and then the transmission cuts out.

units.rawText: Prioritize shield repairs! Track the entropic movements through other cameras and figure out where they're coming from!
units.displayText: Prioritize shield repairs! Track the entropic movements through other cameras and figure out where they're coming from!

spans.text: Prioritize shield repairs! Track the entropic movements through other cameras and figure out where they're coming from!

units.rawText: Roger that!
units.displayText: Roger that!

spans.text: Roger that!

units.rawText: Warning— HQ periphery facilities have been entropized. Entropization is spreading toward central regions. All agents, evacuate immediately!
units.displayText: Warning— HQ periphery facilities have been entropized. Entropization is spreading toward central regions. All agents, evacuate immediately!

spans.text: Warning— HQ periphery facilities have been entropized. Entropization is spreading toward central regions. All agents, evacuate immediately!

units.rawText: All the surveillance devices near Astarte Spaceport have been entropized and radar scans are being impeded!
units.displayText: All the surveillance devices near Astarte Spaceport have been entropized and radar scans are being impeded!

spans.text: All the surveillance devices near Astarte Spaceport have been entropized and radar scans are being impeded!

units.rawText: I can't believe it, all of them. Bring up imaging from all artificial Jovian satellites ASAP.
units.displayText: I can't believe it, all of them. Bring up imaging from all artificial Jovian satellites ASAP.

spans.text: I can't believe it, all of them. Bring up imaging from all artificial Jovian satellites ASAP.

units.rawText: The agents patch the feeds from all the Jovian satellites onto the main screen. Some have been destroyed by the comets, others have been entropized, and the ones further away from the carnage are at bad angles. Gagarin can obtain no usable information from them.
units.displayText: The agents patch the feeds from all the Jovian satellites onto the main screen. Some have been destroyed by the comets, others have been entropized, and the ones further away from the carnage are at bad angles. Gagarin can obtain no usable information from them.

spans.text: The agents patch the feeds from all the Jovian satellites onto the main screen. Some have been destroyed by the comets, others have been entropized, and the ones further away from the carnage are at bad angles. Gagarin can obtain no usable information from them.

units.rawText: The satellites are not at ideal orbits for this.
units.displayText: The satellites are not at ideal orbits for this.

spans.text: The satellites are not at ideal orbits for this.

units.rawText: Try changing them!
units.displayText: Try changing them!

spans.text: Try changing them!

units.rawText: All our artificial satellites are in bad shape from the cometary bombardment. If we change their course drastically, they might end up crashing due to Jupiter's gravity.
units.displayText: All our artificial satellites are in bad shape from the cometary bombardment. If we change their course drastically, they might end up crashing due to Jupiter's gravity.

spans.text: All our artificial satellites are in bad shape from the cometary bombardment. If we change their course drastically, they might end up crashing due to Jupiter's gravity.

units.rawText: We don't have a choice; we NEED to find out where these new entropics are coming from.
units.displayText: We don't have a choice; we NEED to find out where these new entropics are coming from.

spans.text: We don't have a choice; we NEED to find out where these new entropics are coming from.

units.rawText: I'll head out to Astarte Spaceport myself!
units.displayText: I'll head out to Astarte Spaceport myself!

spans.text: I'll head out to Astarte Spaceport myself!

units.rawText: Kaboom! An entropizing shell blasts through the HQ wall. Shrill alarms fill the air.
units.displayText: Kaboom! An entropizing shell blasts through the HQ wall. Shrill alarms fill the air.

spans.text: Kaboom! An entropizing shell blasts through the HQ wall. Shrill alarms fill the air.

units.rawText: Warning— Large-scale entropic incursion detected in the Ops Room!
units.displayText: Warning— Large-scale entropic incursion detected in the Ops Room!

spans.text: Warning— Large-scale entropic incursion detected in the Ops Room!

units.rawText: Team 03, hold off the entropics entering the Ops Room!
units.displayText: Team 03, hold off the entropics entering the Ops Room!

spans.text: Team 03, hold off the entropics entering the Ops Room!

units.rawText: We've lost the west flank of the Ops Room. Team 03 was blindsided by Entropics and is not responding to hails!
units.displayText: We've lost the west flank of the Ops Room. Team 03 was blindsided by Entropics and is not responding to hails!

spans.text: We've lost the west flank of the Ops Room. Team 03 was blindsided by Entropics and is not responding to hails!

units.rawText: Warning— Shield under attack by high-energy weapons. Shield integrity at 25%.
units.displayText: Warning— Shield under attack by high-energy weapons. Shield integrity at 25%.

spans.text: Warning— Shield under attack by high-energy weapons. Shield integrity at 25%.

units.rawText: Warning— Breach detected in blockade net...
units.displayText: Warning— Breach detected in blockade net...

spans.text: Warning— Breach detected in blockade net...

units.rawText: The entropic comets have completely breached the barrier... Astarte Spaceport has fallen! Come back, Gagarin!
units.displayText: The entropic comets have completely breached the barrier... Astarte Spaceport has fallen! Come back, Gagarin!

spans.text: The entropic comets have completely breached the barrier... Astarte Spaceport has fallen! Come back, Gagarin!

units.rawText: We need to find out where these entropics are coming from so we can tell Lord Yuwang!
units.displayText: We need to find out where these entropics are coming from so we can tell Lord Yuwang!

spans.text: We need to find out where these entropics are coming from so we can tell Lord Yuwang!

units.rawText: Gagarin...
units.displayText: Gagarin...

spans.text: Gagarin...

units.rawText: It HAS to be done, or more of our friends will die here!
units.displayText: It HAS to be done, or more of our friends will die here!

spans.text: It HAS to be done, or more of our friends will die here!

units.rawText: <size=40>Gagarin!</size>
units.displayText: Gagarin!

spans.text: Gagarin!

units.rawText: Never mind me, hurry up and fix the barrier and restore the blockade! We can't let those entropic comets through...
units.displayText: Never mind me, hurry up and fix the barrier and restore the blockade! We can't let those entropic comets through...

spans.text: Never mind me, hurry up and fix the barrier and restore the blockade! We can't let those entropic comets through...

units.rawText: Belka knows he can't persuade Gagarin. All he can do is focus on fixing the barrier.
units.displayText: Belka knows he can't persuade Gagarin. All he can do is focus on fixing the barrier.

spans.text: Belka knows he can't persuade Gagarin. All he can do is focus on fixing the barrier.

units.rawText: Jiutian sector, at Astarte Spaceport on the Jovian Ringworld.
units.displayText: Jiutian sector, at Astarte Spaceport on the Jovian Ringworld.

spans.text: Jiutian sector, at Astarte Spaceport on the Jovian Ringworld.

units.rawText: Gathering energy non-stop, Gagarin fires beam after beam from his eyes, blowing away the vanguard of the entropic hordes.
units.displayText: Gathering energy non-stop, Gagarin fires beam after beam from his eyes, blowing away the vanguard of the entropic hordes.

spans.text: Gathering energy non-stop, Gagarin fires beam after beam from his eyes, blowing away the vanguard of the entropic hordes.

units.rawText: Sir, Astarte Spaceport has been completely entropized... All the agents stationed there are...
units.displayText: Sir, Astarte Spaceport has been completely entropized... All the agents stationed there are...

spans.text: Sir, Astarte Spaceport has been completely entropized... All the agents stationed there are...

units.rawText: ...Now is not the time to be sentimental...
units.displayText: ...Now is not the time to be sentimental...

spans.text: ...Now is not the time to be sentimental...

units.rawText: Gagarin moves ahead at full speed, heading towards the telescopes near Astarte Spaceport.
units.displayText: Gagarin moves ahead at full speed, heading towards the telescopes near Astarte Spaceport.

spans.text: Gagarin moves ahead at full speed, heading towards the telescopes near Astarte Spaceport.

units.rawText: Covered by his allies, Gagarin reaches the telescopes while spewing an endless stream of beams.
units.displayText: Covered by his allies, Gagarin reaches the telescopes while spewing an endless stream of beams.

spans.text: Covered by his allies, Gagarin reaches the telescopes while spewing an endless stream of beams.

units.rawText: Retrieving observational data... commencing analysis...
units.displayText: Retrieving observational data... commencing analysis...

spans.text: Retrieving observational data... commencing analysis...

units.rawText: Image after image flashes through Gagarin's neural cloud.
units.displayText: Image after image flashes through Gagarin's neural cloud.

spans.text: Image after image flashes through Gagarin's neural cloud.

units.rawText: ...How is this... even possible...
units.displayText: ...How is this... even possible...

spans.text: ...How is this... even possible...

units.rawText: Not good... I need to inform Lord Yuwang immediately!
units.displayText: Not good... I need to inform Lord Yuwang immediately!

spans.text: Not good... I need to inform Lord Yuwang immediately!

units.rawText: Gagarin, look out!
units.displayText: Gagarin, look out!

spans.text: Gagarin, look out!

units.rawText: Gagarin is so focused on collecting the information that he does not notice the shadow creeping up on him.
units.displayText: Gagarin is so focused on collecting the information that he does not notice the shadow creeping up on him.

spans.text: Gagarin is so focused on collecting the information that he does not notice the shadow creeping up on him.

units.rawText: The purple shadow lurking in a dark corner suddenly erupts into a frenzy of activity and launches itself at Gagarin!
units.displayText: The purple shadow lurking in a dark corner suddenly erupts into a frenzy of activity and launches itself at Gagarin!

spans.text: The purple shadow lurking in a dark corner suddenly erupts into a frenzy of activity and launches itself at Gagarin!

units.rawText: Splotch—
units.displayText: Splotch—

spans.text: Splotch—

units.rawText: Carme has been completely entropized. Our combat teams are not responding to hails.
units.displayText: Carme has been completely entropized. Our combat teams are not responding to hails.

spans.text: Carme has been completely entropized. Our combat teams are not responding to hails.

units.rawText: Team 02 was attacked by entropic forces of unknown origin and we've lost all their signals.
units.displayText: Team 02 was attacked by entropic forces of unknown origin and we've lost all their signals.

spans.text: Team 02 was attacked by entropic forces of unknown origin and we've lost all their signals.

units.rawText: Teams 06, 07 and 11 have taken heavy losses and they are withdrawing to Himalia.
units.displayText: Teams 06, 07 and 11 have taken heavy losses and they are withdrawing to Himalia.

spans.text: Teams 06, 07 and 11 have taken heavy losses and they are withdrawing to Himalia.

units.rawText: An endless stream of bad news pours into the command center, as though even the most determined resistance is pointless in the face of the entropic comets' overwhelming numerical superiority.
units.displayText: An endless stream of bad news pours into the command center, as though even the most determined resistance is pointless in the face of the entropic comets' overwhelming numerical superiority.

spans.text: An endless stream of bad news pours into the command center, as though even the most determined resistance is pointless in the face of the entropic comets' overwhelming numerical superiority.

units.rawText: Beepbeep—There is an emergency transmission from Area B.
units.displayText: Beepbeep—There is an emergency transmission from Area B.

spans.text: Beepbeep—There is an emergency transmission from Area B.

units.rawText: Put it through.
units.displayText: Put it through.

spans.text: Put it through.

units.rawText: On the screen, Gagarin twitches and struggles in a pool of Liquid Entropy. It seems there is important news he must relay.
units.displayText: On the screen, Gagarin twitches and struggles in a pool of Liquid Entropy. It seems there is important news he must relay.

spans.text: On the screen, Gagarin twitches and struggles in a pool of Liquid Entropy. It seems there is important news he must relay.

units.rawText: Lord... Yu#@&wa%¥...
units.displayText: Lord... Yu#@&wa%¥...

spans.text: Lord... Yu#@&wa%¥...

units.rawText: Gagarin?!
units.displayText: Gagarin?!

spans.text: Gagarin?!

units.rawText: Jupi#¥%ter%@...
units.displayText: Jupi#¥%ter%@...

spans.text: Jupi#¥%ter%@...

units.rawText: Gagarin sends Yuwang a video.
units.displayText: Gagarin sends Yuwang a video.

spans.text: Gagarin sends Yuwang a video.

units.rawText: The video depicts the interior of Jupiter melting and collapsing. The scraps of debris floating out from it into the void are mutating into dark purple specks.
units.displayText: The video depicts the interior of Jupiter melting and collapsing. The scraps of debris floating out from it into the void are mutating into dark purple specks.

spans.text: The video depicts the interior of Jupiter melting and collapsing. The scraps of debris floating out from it into the void are mutating into dark purple specks.

units.rawText: In the silence of space, they germinate, metamorphose, and gradually assume their most familiar form—entropics.

units.rawText: No need for that...

units.displayText: The death of a friend leaves Yuwang nearly unable to breathe.

spans.text: The death of a friend leaves Yuwang nearly unable to breathe.

units.rawText: It is only now that he finally understands why the entropics and comets seem to be everywhere, why all his preparations have always been too late.

units.displayText: Entropy is the natural process of a system going from ordered to disordered...

spans.text: Entropy is the natural process of a system going from ordered to disordered...

units.rawText: It isn't just these external comets that harbor entropics... Once the time comes, any celestial body will entropize from the inside out...
units.displayText: It isn't just these external comets that harbor entropics... Once the time comes, any celestial body will entropize from the inside out...

spans.text: It isn't just these external comets that harbor entropics... Once the time comes, any celestial body will entropize from the inside out...

units.rawText: Are we insignificant beings trying to fight an eternal principle of the universe...

units.displayText: Could it be...
